title: Modern ES Feature Tour (ES2015 → ES2025)
html:
What arrived in each edition since the ES2015 revolution — a map for reading any codebase and for “what's new in JavaScript?” questions.

EditionHeadline features
ES2015 (ES6)let/const, arrows, classes, template literals, destructuring, default/rest/spread, modules, Promise, Map/Set/WeakMap, Symbol, iterators, generators, for…of, Proxy/Reflect
ES2016** exponent, Array.prototype.includes
ES2017async/await, Object.values/entries, padStart/padEnd, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors, SharedArrayBuffer/Atomics
ES2018Object rest/spread, async iteration (for await), Promise.finally, regex named groups, lookbehind, s flag
ES2019flat/flatMap, Object.fromEntries, trimStart/trimEnd, optional catch binding, stable sort
ES2020?., ??, BigInt, Promise.allSettled, globalThis, dynamic import(), matchAll
ES2021&&= ||= ??=, replaceAll, Promise.any, numeric separators 1_000, WeakRef
ES2022Class fields, #private, static blocks, top-level await, .at(), Object.hasOwn, Error cause, #x in obj
ES2023toSorted/toReversed/toSpliced/with, findLast/findLastIndex, hashbang, symbols as WeakMap keys
ES2024Object.groupBy/Map.groupBy, Promise.withResolvers, Array.fromAsync, regex v flag, resizable ArrayBuffer, String.isWellFormed
ES2025Iterator helpers, new Set methods (union, intersection…), RegExp.escape, Promise.try, JSON modules / import attributes, Float16Array

A tour in one program

On the horizon

ProposalWhat it adds
TemporalModern immutable date/time API replacing Date
Explicit resource managementusing res = getResource() — automatic cleanup via Symbol.dispose
Decorators@logged method() {} — standardised class decorators (used by TypeScript/Angular)
Import defer / source phase importsLazier module evaluation, WebAssembly integration

How features arrive: the TC39 process

1
Stage 0–1
Idea and proposal with a champion on the TC39 committee.
2
Stage 2 / 2.7
Draft spec text chosen; 2.7 = approved in principle, awaiting tests.
3
Stage 3
Recommended for implementation; engines ship it (often behind flags).
4
Stage 4
Two shipping implementations + tests → included in the next yearly edition.
Key point

Transpilers (Babel, TypeScript, esbuild, SWC) convert new syntax to older syntax; polyfills (core-js) add missing built-in functions. Syntax cannot be polyfilled — it must be transpiled.

What were the most important ES6 features?

let/const (block scope), arrow functions, classes, template literals, destructuring, default/rest/spread, modules, promises, Map/Set, symbols, iterators/generators and for…of.
